card.name: Words just before help or give
card.fires_on: Small words such as she, we, they, and, from or a quote mark, where the next word is likely a verb of helping, giving or acting. Seen in rescue stories, charity text and licensing notices.

modes.label: Subject before an action
modes.description: A pronoun subject, after which a verb of helping or doing is expected.
modes.example: Statistics may stun us, but there's so much<< we>> can do to impact change.

modes.label: Rescue story
modes.description: A pronoun or linking word in a story about a nurse who gave aid to a child.
modes.example: Mickschl, who works at Midwest Children’s Resource Center, called upon her training<< and>> performed CPR on the boy.

modes.label: Licensing notice
modes.description: A word or period in a note about content used under a license.
modes.example: This page uses Creative Commons Licensed content<< from>> Wikipedia (view authors).

card.writes: It pushes down help and assist words in English and Chinese, so the next word is less likely to be one of them.
card.plain: It fires on small words right before a verb, and it makes the model less likely to write help or assist next.
